doc.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022

title: Career reflections, upcoming Chick projects and goodbyes
summary: Kirsh calls his life fulfilling, mentions upcoming Electric Band and live albums from the vault, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well I appreciate your time and as I said I’m envious, not envious, I’m happy for your career and as you said all the things you’ve helped deliver to millions of listeners.
Yeah well I mean things are not over yet but it’s certainly up until this point been a very fulfilling, adventurous life.

Well we’ve got, you know still trying to keep an eye on Chick’s legacy. So we’ve got a new Electric Band album that’s coming out, a new live album that’s coming out. We’ve got another, it’s kind of a quasi-classical — not classical, well sort of classical jazz you know kind of thing that was recorded live in Europe. And just various projects —a vault of — I mean I would record every show, multi-track. So there’s a lot to choose from plus there’s stuff that’s never seen the light of day so hopefully they will and just keep Chick’s music coming out and helping people live a better life.
I can’t think of a better way to wrap up. Thanks a lot, Bernie.
Yeah, my pleasure. Good talking with you.
I’ll just pause this and then we’ll have our good-byes.
